text:
mina: quick heads-up  onboarding Eos9B-int4 (Gemma-derived) and seeing poor QA on long docs. short prompts fine.

raj: numbers pls + how you quantized?

mina: baseline fp16 rougeL 43.0 / qa-f1 69.0. int4 -> rougeL 37.2 / qa-f1 61.5. used `gptq` group 128 per-channel. command: ```./tools/convert_model --in eos9b.fp16 --out eos9b.int4 --method gptq --g=128```.

lex: any repeating tokens or decoding anomalies? token id overlap?

mina: yes repeating run-on tokens near high ids on long ctx. eg tokens [50210,50211,50212] -> decoded ["the","the","\\u200b"] which is wrong, we expect words not zwj.

tom: could be rotary param mismatch. Some Gemma forks switched to head-global scale. What rotary mode did convert assume?

mina: convert default = headwise. upstream Eos9B release uses global_shared scaling. missed that in metadata.yaml.

raj: that explains phase skew across heads; quant noise makes it worse. try re-export or convert with `--rotary-mode=shared` and re-run quick eval.

mina: did that, intermediate looks better: int4(shared) rougeL 42.0 / qa-f1 68.0 (still small delta).

ci-bot: nightly/eval/6527800000 completed: fp16=43.0 int4(shared)=42.0 int4(headwise)=37.2.

lex: good signal. still suspicious about the zwj token. maybe tokenizer remap or extra sentinel tokens appended in their tokenizer.json. Did you use archive tokenizer or canonical repo tokenizer?

mina: archive tokenizer (packaged). convert does naive `vocab_sz = len(vocab)` then slices rotary tables by vocab_sz*head_dim. if tokenizer added sentinels, the mapping and special ids got shifted.

tom: we should treat tokenizer as authoritative input. add `--tokenizer-path` and remap token ids when converting. also a tiny probe to autodetect rotary mode helps.

raj: I sketched a probe script: runs in ~3-6s, compares cos/sin matrices per-head vs shared and reports mean diff. use `--probe-rotary` during onboarding. snippet: ```python
m = load_model(path)
cos0, sin0 = extract_rotary(m, layer=0)
# compute difference between per-head tiled and shared
print(((cos0_tiled - cos0_shared).abs().mean()).item())
```

mina: will add tokenizer arg + safe remap and wire probe into CI. also adding a small smoke test: quantize first 10 layers and decode a sentinel-heavy trace to validate token ids.

lex: please add a unit test checking that tokens in the tail (vocab-5..vocab-1) decode identically to upstream. avoids silent remap bugs.

mina: ack. plan: 1) convert w/ shared rotary to confirm, 2) patch convert tool to accept tokenizer path + remap, 3) add rotary probe and tail-decoding test in model-tools.

ci-bot: draft-pr/3379 created by mina: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-tools/pull/3379 (tokenizer remap + rotary-probe + tests).

raj: will review, esp tests around quant determinism. also add a note to onboarding checklist: "rotary-mode + tokenizer remap verified" for Gemma/Mistral forks.

mina: after applying patch and redoing full eval: int4 rougeL 42.6 / qa-f1 68.4. long-ctx hallucination rate down ~50%. thanks team.

tom: filing follow-up: some Qwen exports we saw earlier also append sentinel tokens; reuse remap code there.

ci-bot: thread archived at 6527800275.
